goal: Tell an engineering leader, in one word, whether a content-addressed platform is ready to roll out: go, hold or no-go.

app.name: rollout-gate
app.title: Rollout gate
app.purpose: Decide, as a DMN decision table with hit policy FIRST, whether a kappa-registry platform may roll out, from its conformance verdict, its signing key backup, its data backup, whether its environment is pinned and whether its images were admitted.
limits: It decides from the verdicts the other apps give; it runs none of them.
Budget and staffing are outside it.

fields.name: conformance
fields.means: the conformance verdict of the registry

fields.name: key
fields.means: whether the node's Ed25519 signing key in keys/ is backed up

fields.name: backup
fields.means: whether blobs/ and state.redb are backed up

fields.name: env
fields.means: whether the toolchain is pinned by a Nix flake lock

fields.name: images
fields.means: whether every image the rollout needs was admitted

meanings.hold: nothing is broken, but something is unproven or unprotected; fix it and ask again
meanings.no-go: something is broken that a rollout would make worse

rules.why: kappa-registry README: losing the signing key loses every capability edge, delegation chain and epoch signature
a MUST failure means clients cannot rely on the protocol
a workload whose image was refused cannot run
an untested registry is unproven, not broken
kappa-registry README: back up blobs/, state.redb and keys/
kappa-distribution CLAUDE.md: the toolchain is hermetic via Nix, so a drifting one cannot reproduce the build

app.otherwiseWhy: conformant, keyed, backed up, pinned and admitted

properties.why: never roll out a node whose identity could be lost
never roll out an untested registry
never roll out without a complete backup
a nonconformant registry is always no-go

stakeholders.name: Engineering leader
stakeholders.text: Decides when the platform ships and needs one word, go, hold or no-go, with the reason, not a test report.

stakeholders.name: Business owner
stakeholders.text: Pays for storage and answers for data loss, and needs both kept down without reading the protocol.

concerns.name: One word with its reason
concerns.text: The rollout answer is go, hold or no-go, and every no-go and hold names the rule that gave it.
